title: Global weak solutions to a diffuse-interface model for quasi-incompressible two-phase flows with unmatched densities and singular potential
summary: We study a thermodynamically consistent diffuse-interface model that describes the motion of two macroscopically immiscible, incompressible, and viscous Newtonian fluids with unmatched densities. This model is compatible with continuum mixture theory. It adopts a mass-averaged (barycentric) velocity so that the two-phase flow is quasi-incompressible: the velocity is no longer divergence-free, and the pressure enters the equation of the chemical potential.
